General32_observations_actually_read: FishingRodItem.use chooses retrieve from nonnull player.fishing; otherwise server reads rod fishing Luck/Lure and requests new FishingHook. addFreshEntity boolean is uninspected. Sound/stats/game events do not certify hook admission or paid material.

FishingHook captures nonnegative luck/lureSpeed without upper clamp. Its player constructor sets owner/player.fishing before launch placement/velocity and before Rod.use requests admission. Pointer presence is not an admitted live bobber acknowledgement; no reproduced stale-pointer exploit is claimed.

Server continuation requires owner alive/not removed, either hand canPerformAction(FISHING_ROD_CAST), distance squared<=1024. Owner null discards; server stop discards. This checks an eligible held-action item, not equality to the original casting stack or a paid prerequisite.
onGround life increments and discards at1200 delivered ticks; airborne resets life0. This is not a1200 total lifetime or measured world/wall-clock deadline.

FLYING changes to entity-hooked or BOBBING at positive local water height; hooked entity remains followed only while nonremoved/same dimension, else reference clears and returns FLYING. Full collision/projectile/physics/event engine is outside this bounded chain.

BOBBING resets openWater=true when nibble<=0 and timeUntilHooked<=0, including lure-wait phase. Otherwise it AND-latches prior openWater, previous outOfWaterTime<10 and geometry scan. That test precedes this tick water-counter update; not an instantaneous fresh geometry test at retrieval.

In-water counter decrements to0; out-of-water increments capped10. catchingFish runs only on server with positive local water height. Dry intervals can pause timers rather than guarantee a real-time bite deadline.

Open-water scan covers 5x5 horizontal cells on four layers y-1..y+2. Each layer reduces to one uniform type; source water with empty collision is INSIDE, air/lily pad ABOVE. INVALID, initial ABOVE or water following ABOVE fails. This gates raw treasure predicate, not all fishing success.

catchingFish phase increment starts1, independently adds for rain RNG<.25 and subtracts for sky-covered RNG<.5, yielding0..2. It affects lure/approach counters; nibble decrements1 per eligible catching call. Weather particles/splash do not acknowledge a fish item.

Lure initialization random100..600 subtracts lureSpeed*100; positive wait expiration then creates approach20..80. Nonpositive initialization can be reinitialized on subsequent calls rather than necessarily progressing. No upper-enchantment-clamp, fixed elapsed seconds or guaranteed high-level reward is inferred.

Approach expiration opens nibble20..40 and synced biting cue. Nibble expiration clears waiting/approach and biting. Transient timer/cue is an opportunity to request reel output, not owned fish stock or a paid-material voucher.

Retrieval is server and valid-owner gated. Hooked entity takes pull velocity, empty-list fishing criterion and broadcast branch with default rod damage3 for ItemEntity or5 otherwise; it does not generate table fish in that branch.

FISHING parameter-set requires ORIGIN and TOOL, optionally THIS_ENTITY and Forge KILLER_ENTITY. Hook passes THIS_ENTITY twice with same value. Raw entity=this is mapped by LootContext.EntityTarget to hook context, not silently to player owner.

Actual fixed root JSON has one pool/roll with junk10 quality-2, treasure5 quality2, fish85 quality-1. Only treasure entry requires entity_properties(this) type_specific fishing_hook/in_open_water=true. These are raw base definitions, not measured/current loaded probabilities or guaranteed output.

four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: 耳塞实时准入与撤销、来源占用和牵引生命周期整链1，不按耳塞名称、3轴、邻近Sirens、两个包包装或粒子拆数，与既有Gorgon替代和Cockatrice减速独立最终控制生产。getSingTime只读，tick写回相同时间；本岗当前已缓存源码内CharmeTime只在此定义，不能据maxSingTime断言自然超时一定发生。外层siren无效/不再唱时没有清旧flag；距离退出仅在外层成立后检查。runtime ID只检当前world EntitySiren，无UUID/维度epoch；已有flag和已解析来源不能推导真实效果仍活动。歌声/音乐粒子按歌手状态，不是耳塞拒控回执，局部心粒子也不证明PropertiesMessage实收。攻击pull忽略hurt结果且可转玩家朝向，和charm分支不改玩家朝向必须区分；不将hurt=false当Boss免疫。

four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations: 只计本项目闭合的实际控制准入/撤销生产及LivingUpdate消费；Citadel外部PropertiesMessage接收与NBT同步底层未取得，作为广播支持0，绝不称TCP/晚加入同步通过。MessageSirenSong handler未enqueueWork且未限制server接收后修改来源，静态记录实际边界但未运行复现/定性漏洞。常规导航模型及音乐粒子消费者未展开，不声称实机观感；无正式修改/游戏。

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation: 真实CandyCaneHookItem.use server构造发射带owner/手别的hook→tick扫描最近实体偏好worm或onHitEntity把segment转head→保存hooked UUID→server按当前world UUID解析，client numeric ID→未reeling且owner非shift时吸向riding segment/尝试startRiding并setHookId(offhand,id)。worm getHook按同步ID解析；isRidingPlayer要求左右hook均是CandyCaneHook且均有owner、候选entity.is(leftOwner)。头和segment isInvulnerableTo拒该source.getEntity；真实注册RidingGoal嘴部AOE同资格排除此entity，互相保护合并。
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: 一个随两锚点活对象关系生效的原生双向伤害安全政策1，区别持久tame owner、显式shift友伤许可、被抓受害者随机拒伤；不按头/分节/嘴部、左右手或钩生成/同步方法另计。名字riding不是真正乘坐验证，owner1和owner2只要求非null，不检查二者同一；实际只匹配leftOwner，不匹配ridingPlayer字段或乘客表。source归属实体而非direct，所以不将投射物直击误排。少任一有效owner就失去此特定安全门；getHook不显式alive/UUID验证，数字ID解析有边界，不称所有旧状态即时清理。hook.reeling停止setHookId但未直接清worm旧ID，直到getEntity解析改变；remove只postReel清持物UUID，不能说每次释放原子撤销。
four_business_fields_actually_read.application_to_boss_immune: 不掉血可能是动态关系安全政策，不能统一写Boss免控。正式回执需目标/实际原因、资格对象与生命周期一致；不能用骑乘字段/客户端视觉或固定ID替代服务端当前目标关系。普通玩家类型9不新增Boss灰字。
four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations: 完整hook/item类、worm native tick/判定/goal、segment原生tick/拒伤/头解析/释放方法已读。此处hook UUID关系不依赖hurt成功，mount/addFreshEntity返回也未检验，发射/收线声不证明抓获接纳。segment hurt即使转交head也返回false，和既账通用multipart relay合并0，不推导Boss免疫；拒伤方法没有灰字或独立拒控嗡声。MountedEntityKeyMessage包/平台乘坐强制退出内部未展开，不声称C2S安全/全部输入闭环；只作为已读segment行为上下文0。没有修改模型、照搬相机钳制（原positionRider会clampRotation）或开启游戏。

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation:
Current fixed native source registration ties CommonProxy Forge EventHelperDamageCancelling listeners, item primer Blink/Grapple factories and registered hook entity/custom client factory. Exact earlier Main050bootstrap/primer/network chain reused, NameUtil from actual Main051 read. Local bounded Java search found only Blink launch and Hook pull as mark callers, both FALL; helper has no shown clear/reset/logout/clone/stop API. Registration excerpts only, not complete RegistryItems/Entities files or installed item availability.
Blink sneak cycles stack persistent blinkMode ordinal and sends actionbar mode text; normal right-click with no item cooldown starts active hand. ServerPlayer stopped-use selects current mode without repeating cooldown gate. LAUNCH computes held-time strength using flying0.8/nonflying2.4, requires>.3, pays fixed850*.8=680 shared charge, writes look motion/fallDistance0, optionally schedules captured player startFallFlying via physical proxy, sends motion FX, then marks FALL only if currently not elytraflying. Charge affordability/delivery/displacement are separate; no launch cooldown set. TELEPORT branch is excluded from novel policy, helpers unexpanded.
ClientProxy queues mantle callback through ClientScheduler CLIENT END; CommonProxy implementation is empty. Mantle gate is actual chest mantle, weak expected Vicio constellation and enabled effect. Scheduler predecrements, callbacks enqueued during tick wait until iteration ends. No authoritative S2C two-tick flight transition, correct world/player ownership or native engine flight result is guaranteed. Shared050resource state and regen-only sync/HUD are reused0; holding preview varies .2..1*850 while actual launch remains680.
Grapple server rightclick pays450 then attempts addEntity and sets40 item cooldown without spawn result. Hook retains thrower, block hit anchors itself, living hit excludes self but no team/Boss gate and follows hit anchor. It moves thrower, not anchor. Unlatched age30, missing/dead thrower, proximity or nonimproving-distance timeout start despawn. Valid pull writes fallDistance-2, bounded acceleration/first-pull impulse on either side and server helper enrolls player FALL. Subsequent pulls can re-enroll after consumption/ground-clear; already-present repeated marks coalesce, not stacked future falls.
Owner is private static UUID -> HashSet<DamageSource>. No stack/cast/producer entity/session/dimension/generation/expiry/amount recorded. Source equality is Java set equality; native DamageSource equality not expanded. A matching Player LivingHurt removes source, drops outer UUID if empty and cancels, without logical-side/positiveamount/currenttool/motion/cooldown/charge check. Unrelated source does not consume. Another server PlayerTick END onGround removes FALL only and leaves empty outer map. Competing landing/hurt/END ordering is native external boundary, not guaranteed normal safe landing or demonstrated loss/exploit.
Hook despawn/removal/held-item changes do not revoke token in shown code. Reused EventHandlerCache logout/Clone/serverstop callbacks do not clear this private helper map; fresh process initializes a new map. Nonempty token can retain until matching injury/ground tick; grounded empty UUID entry can remain. This is a conditional source lifetime observation, not process-persistent NBT, actual world transfer or cross-side steal. No actual native event delivery/collision/movement/canceled-order reproduction.
PktShootEntity sends entity intID, optional vector, effectbool/length; client enqueue looks up current world intID, writes motion and submits300particles based on current look/strength. No UUID/epoch/result/ack/retry; sending target point separately carries dimension. Optional codec permits null but normal producer supplies vector, so null dereference remains protocol boundary only. Launch FX precedes marker and can be sent in already-flying branch with no token; marker/ground-clear/hurtcancel send no custom refusal cue. Despawn sparkles concern hook removal only; external renderer/native net scheduling/assets not visually or audibly accepted.
Closest Goety stamp connects attack to immediately following knockback within tick window, consumes even stale stamps. Here movement-issued same-source entitlement coalesces and can survive motion source removal until one matching hurt or independent grounded invalidation, with no timestamp deadline. Arcanus one-use danger-sense potion rolls only on qualified attack, possibly teleports then consumes; it has native effect duration and no movement-issued re-enrollment or competing grounded cleanup. Combined enrollment/consumption/cleanup ownership differs, not merely FALL constant/UUID map/wand variant. All sharedcharge/network/scheduler/particles/defaults/bugs0. One bounded whole related policy accepted1, no new migration/runtime/production credit.
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: Movement-issued source token is coalesced per UUID/source, with one matching hurt consuming while unrelated hurt preserves, and grounded END independently invalidates. Repeated valid hook pulls may re-enroll, producer removal does not revoke. This whole lifecycle differs from attack-correlating tick stamp and attack-triggered consumable danger-sense potion, not merely another FALL constant.

每次use在当前手stack取HOOK_ENTITY_ID缺省0，当前Level按numericID找到LyssaHook就调用其handleHookRetraction后把本stackID写0；没有本地hook owner==本次player、UUID/dimension/session token校验。查不到同类则先音效，再server构造setOwner/射出并addFreshEntity，不验bool即存hookID；无论分支都SUCCESS。

完整tick在super后执行helper；helper仅hookalive、无hookedtarget且当前格没有正水高时，将附近ItemEntity速度改为指向hook的.4单位向量。不请求伤害/位移许可，非玩家自动入包，也不是物品已交付。
服务端retraction取当前hookedIn；只有nonnull+真正hookowner蹲下+canStealFromEntity才进偷取并discard；canSteal要求Living、player配置许可、类型不在缓存blockedSet。配置拒偷/非蹲下时只要owner还在且hookedInnonnull，仍bringInHookedEntity→nativepullEntity→按item*4/livingY*1.5加速、广播byte31、discard。故拒偷不拒另一种身体拉动。
无hooked或无owner落到super.retrieve(stack)，该返回值未被调用者使用。整个server分支之后仍pullItemEntitiesWithHook，查询hook附近ItemEntity并按owner与hook坐标赋速度；这在已discard后也会调用，方法本地没有alive门。不能把discard直接等同该次所有副作用已终止。
完整canSteal类型blocklist首次懒初始化成Set<EntityType>；unknown registry getOptional丢掉，validator pattern只允许[a-z1-9_.-]不含0，parse可能拒不合规范。已读onFileChange仅重置mobcharm/sojourner缓存，没有此处清理；其他外部修改/加载不穷尽，不能承诺运行reload行为。
偷取先均匀随机EquipmentSlot.values()[rand]，getItemBySlot拿实际stack。只有初始empty且stealFromVacantSlots=true才扫所有slot找首非空且canDropFromSlot；配置注释说false会搜索，与实际iftrue不同。随机初始非空时完全不查该dropchance门。
fallback扫描每轮先把stolenStack改成该槽stack，只在找到非空且可drop时更新slotBeingStolenFrom后break。若最终没有合格槽，但最后槽非空且不可drop，stolenStack可保留最后值而slotBeingStolenFrom仍初始empty槽。后续消费这两个变量分开，存在本地槽/载荷对应边界；不执行、不称实机复制或物品损失。
失败factor开启leveled时1/(sqrt(max1,min玩家level,cap))*2，cap默认100范围1..900；否则flat默认10范围0..100/100。实际return条件是(random<=factor OR empty且failVacant) AND angerOnStealFailure。anger=false会跳过这一失败return，而非只静默处理失败；默认angertrue。
失败分支只hurt(playerAttack,0)请求再return，不读取是否hurt接纳或实际发怒；外层仍discard/清rodID并执行末尾附近物品拉动。无特定拒控text/reason或收费/冷却成功回执。
非空stolenStack且ServerLevel才随机损耐久0..2，hurtAndBreak callback空；损坏后非空才创建ItemEntity，设置pickupDelay5和朝owner速度，addFreshEntity结果忽略，最后无论drop生成/损坏结果都setItemSlot原slot EMPTY。实际库存清槽与成功落地/入包不是一件事。
